changeSet.author: v.ledvanov
changeSet.comment: Создание таблицы компаний с признаками профиля и индексами для поиска по группе и ОКВЭД.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE companies ( company_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MISSING' CHECK (profile_status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'MISSING', 'CONFLICTING')), organization_type TEXT, ownership_type TEXT, age_range TEXT, business_lifecycle_stage TEXT, main_industry_code TEXT, main_industry_name TEXT, negative_mark BOOLEAN, employee_count_range_fns TEXT, employee_count_range_spark TEXT, client_type TEXT, has_settlement_account BOOLEAN, has_bank_guarantee BOOLEAN, has_loan BOOLEAN, has_leasing BOOLEAN, has_deposit BOOLEAN, has_payroll_project BOOLEAN, has_foreign_trade BOOLEAN, foreign_trade_countries TEXT, has_factoring BOOLEAN, revenue NUMERIC CHECK (revenue >= 0), group_id TEXT, city TEXT, region TEXT ); CREATE INDEX companies_group_id_idx ON companies (group_id); CREATE INDEX companies_main_industry_code_idx ON companies (main_industry_code);
